source: NCERT Class VIII, Curiosity: Textbook of Science, Ch. 2.

sections.heading: 1. The Invisible Living World
points: **Microorganisms (microbes)** are tiny living things **not visible to the naked eye** — seen only under a **microscope**.
Major groups: **bacteria, fungi, protozoa, algae**, and the **viruses** (which reproduce only inside a host).
They live everywhere — air, water, soil, and in and on other living things.

sections.heading: 2. Useful Microorganisms
points: **Food:** **Lactobacillus** makes curd; **yeast** ferments dough/sugar (bread, idli, alcohol).
**Agriculture:** **Rhizobium** (in legume roots) and blue-green algae **fix nitrogen** → enrich soil.
**Medicine:** **antibiotics** (e.g. penicillin from a fungus); **vaccines** build immunity.
**Environment:** **decomposers** break down dead matter and recycle nutrients.

sections.heading: 3. Harmful Microorganisms
points: **Pathogens** cause disease: bacteria (TB, cholera, typhoid), viruses (cold, flu, polio, COVID-19), protozoa (malaria via **female Anopheles mosquito**), fungi (skin infections).
Some spoil food or cause **food poisoning**.
Diseases spread through **air, water, food, contact and carriers** (mosquitoes, houseflies).

sections.heading: 4. Food Preservation and Prevention
points: **Preservation:** salting, sugaring, drying, refrigeration, boiling, **pasteurisation** (Louis Pasteur), preservatives.
Prevent disease: **clean water, hygiene, vaccination, controlling carriers**.
**Immunity** and **vaccines** protect the body against microbes.

sections.heading: 5. High-Yield One-Liners (Last-Minute Recall)
points: Microbes: bacteria, fungi, protozoa, algae, viruses (virus needs a host).
Curd = Lactobacillus; bread/alcohol = yeast; antibiotics (penicillin from fungus).
Nitrogen fixation = Rhizobium (legumes) + blue-green algae.
Malaria = protozoan via female Anopheles mosquito.
Preservation: salting, drying, refrigeration, pasteurisation.

sections.heading: 6. Common Traps (Watch Out)
points: **Malaria** = protozoan (Plasmodium), spread by **female Anopheles** mosquito.
**Curd** = Lactobacillus; **fermentation** = yeast.
**Antibiotics** target bacteria/fungi; **viruses** need **vaccines**.
**Rhizobium** fixes nitrogen in **legume root nodules**.
